entries.title: Zechariah 6:1
segments:
Four chariots; these represent the various providential instruments of mercy and justice which God employs. 
 
  Two mountains--of brass; these are generally understood as a symbol of God's firm and immutable decrees. 
 
vv 1-8. 
 
God's purposes are like mountains of brass, firm and immutable.  They extend to all the affairs of this world, and will all be executed at the appointed time.  Though for a season the enemies of the church may seem to have power in their own hands, he is still using them for the accomplishment of his gracious purposes concerning her; and can with infinite ease destroy them whenever her welfare shall require it.

entries.title: Zechariah 6:5
segments: Spirits of the heavens; or, "winds of the heavens;" here, as in
, a symbol of the agencies that produce overturnings and revolutions in the earth.  If we retain the idea of heavenly spirits, the meaning will be substantially the same.

entries.title: Zechariah 6:6
segments: Into the north country; the seat of both the Babylonian empire and the Persian that succeeded it.  See note on

.  The black horses seem to denote the calamities which God will send upon the persecutors of his people, especially the Chaldeans, whose destruction had been only begun by the conquest of Cyrus; the white, those victories which contribute to the deliverance and enlargement of God's people.

entries.title: Zechariah 6:7
segments: The bay; their office is general.

entries.title: Zechariah 6:8
segments: Have quieted my spirit; by executing my wrath on the persecutors of my people.

entries.title: Zechariah 6:9
segments:
vv 9-15. 
 
The kings and priests of ancient Israel were types of the Lord Jesus Christ, who unites in his person both offices.  As a priest, he has expiated the sins of his people by his own blood; as a king, he has recieved from the Father all power in heaven and on earth, and he orders all things for their good.  Under his reign the spiritual temple must be builded from age to age, till all nations shall come and worship him.

entries.title: Zechariah 6:11
segments: Make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua; Joshua is crowned, that he may thus represent the union of the kingly and priestly office in our Saviour's person, who is "The BRANCH" here spoken of.

entries.title: Zechariah 6:13
segments:
The counsel of peace; the plan of reconciling men to God. 
 
  Between them both; generally understood to mean, between Christ's kingly and priestly offices.  The counsel of peace is accomplished by the union of these two in one divine person.
